name: Early-onset severe Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome with hearing loss due to AP3D1 deficiency
aliases: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome with sensorineural hearing loss

criteria.description: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism with hypopigmentation of skin, hair, and eyes
Bleeding diathesis due to platelet storage pool deficiency
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the AP3D1 gene
Evidence of progressive pulmonary fibrosis on imaging or clinical exam

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism, bleeding diathesis, sensorineural hearing loss, and confirmed biallelic AP3D1 pathogenic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; clinical features overlap with other Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome subtypes but hearing loss is distinctive for AP3D1 deficiency.

pathognomonic.notes: Hypopigmentation of skin, hair, and iris

pathognomonic.symptomName: Platelet storage pool deficiency causing bleeding diathesis
pathognomonic.notes: Prolonged bleeding due to absent dense granules in platelets
Bilateral progressive hearing impairment starting in infancy or early childhood
searchTerms: early hearing loss from nerve damage

common.notes: Involuntary eye movements associated with visual impairment
Light sensitivity due to iris hypopigmentation
Progressive interstitial lung disease typically developing in childhood
Increased tendency to bruise due to platelet dysfunction
Visual impairment related to retinal hypopigmentation and foveal hypoplasia

occasional.notes: Inflammatory bowel disease-like symptoms reported in some patients
Secondary to pulmonary fibrosis and impaired mucociliary clearance
Reported in some cases, possibly secondary to sensory deficits

rare.notes: Occasional reports of mild renal impairment
Rare occurrence, possibly secondary to hypoxia or metabolic disturbances

laboratory: Platelet electron microscopy showing absent dense granules
Prolonged bleeding time with normal platelet count
imaging: High-resolution chest CT showing interstitial lung fibrosis
Brain MRI typically normal or nonspecific
other: Ophthalmologic exam showing iris transillumination and foveal hypoplasia

distinguishingFeatures: Similar bleeding diathesis and pulmonary fibrosis
Presence of giant lysosomal granules in leukocytes

redFlags: Severe bleeding episodes disproportionate to trauma
Progressive sensorineural hearing loss in infancy
Early signs of pulmonary fibrosis with respiratory compromise
references: Gochuico BR, et al. Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome type 10 (AP3D1 deficiency): clinical and molecular characterization. Am J Hum Genet. 2017.
Wei ML. Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome: a disease of protein trafficking and organelle function. Pigment Cell Res. 2006.
Huizing M, et al. Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome: mutation update. Hum Mutat. 2004.
